no_go_policies: No auto-publishing — every action requires human approval
No causal guarantees — refreshing may not reverse the decline
No actions on pages with fewer than 15 active days in the feature window

monitoring_triggers.M1: Queue regeneration required if older than 45 days
monitoring_triggers.M2: Halt if human editor acceptance rate drops below 25%
monitoring_triggers.M3: Trigger audit if time-aware fold P@50 drops below 0.30 (already fired in W6)
